import warnings

import numpy as np
import pytest

import xarray as xr


def test_integrate_coord_keyword():
    da = xr.DataArray(
        np.arange(12).reshape(4, 3),
        dims=["x", "y"],
        coords={"x": [0, 0.1, 1.1, 1.2]},
    )
    expected = da.integrate("x")
    actual = da.integrate(coord="x")
    assert np.allclose(expected.values, actual.values)
    assert actual.dims == ("y",)


def test_integrate_dim_deprecated():
    da = xr.DataArray(
        np.arange(12).reshape(4, 3),
        dims=["x", "y"],
        coords={"x": [0, 0.1, 1.1, 1.2]},
    )
    with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning):
        actual = da.integrate(dim="x")
    expected = da.integrate("x")
    assert np.allclose(expected.values, actual.values)
    assert actual.dims == ("y",)


def test_integrate_coord_and_dim_raises():
    da = xr.DataArray(np.arange(4), dims=["x"], coords={"x": [0, 1, 2, 3]})
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        da.integrate("x", dim="x")
